messages.content: Uncle Franky has purchased two boxes of apples, each containing forty apples. He intends to distribute these apples into packs, with each pack containing eight apples. How many apple packs can Uncle Franky create from the two boxes of apples he has?

content.text:
Each box has 40 apples, so two boxes have 40 × 2 = 80 apples total.

Each pack contains 8 apples, so the number of packs is 80 ÷ 8 = 10 packs.

Uncle Franky can create **10 apple packs**.
